column1: # One row per (file, value) pair a chart template writes literally: the census
# in chart_template_literals_contract_test.rs reads every number outside {{ }}
# actions and comments, counts its occurrences, and holds the set to these rows.
# kind is fixed (an identity that is not a dial: a protocol port, a UID, a file
# mode, a shell exit status) or dial (a number a deployment may want to change
# that has no home in values.yaml yet -- the debt, whose ceiling only goes down).
# A dial row names the values.yaml key the number is going to move to.
